نَخَّاسٌ A goader of beasts. (Msb.) ―
-b2- And hence, (S, * A, * Msb,) A seller of beasts; (K;) one who acts as a broker for the sale of beasts (Mgh, Msb) and the like: (Msb:) and a seller of slaves: (K;) sometimes used in the latter sense: (TA:) a genuine Arabic word. (IDrd.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
